summary: FirstEnergy Transmission, LLC (FET) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fifth Amended and Restated LLC Agreement among FET, FirstEnergy Corp., and its joint venture partner (Brookfield affiliate). The agreement updates governance arrangements for FET's participation in two new transmission joint ventures (Valley Link and Grid Growth), but does not alter ownership percentages (FirstEnergy retains 50.1%, Investor holds 49.9%), board composition, or scope of investor consent rights. No financial terms, price per share, or premium were disclosed. This is an internal governance update, not a standalone acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement with no structural implications for trading.
